newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Dollar eyes 1.7350 marks in Europe.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Dollar eyes 1.7350 marks in Europe.

text.p: The dollar is looking perky on the charts, with an assault on 1.7350 marks expected after its bounce from 1.7220-mark lows on Wednesday, said chartists.
"It is in a sideways consolidation phase, momentum indicators are still slightly positive, with a test on 1.7350 marks expected," said Nico Bakker, technical analyst at ABN AMRO.
Bakker said a push through 1.7350 marks would clear the way for dollar/mark to test recent highs just above 1.74 marks.
At 0705 GMT, dollar/mark was trading at 1.7319/26 against 1.7320/30 marks in late Europe on Wednesday.

On the downside Bakker cited support at 1.7300 marks, and below that support around Wednesday's lows of 1.7220 marks should hold. The 1.7220/10 area marked the peaks in early March and was a pivot point for trading in early June.
Beyond that, stiff support sits around 1.7120 marks.
Against the yen, the dollar was seen ambling sideways with little momentum to encourage it either way, said analysts.
"We are in consolidating markets...especially for dollar/yen in the short term," said Bakker.
At 0720 GMT, dollar/yen stood at 113.33/43 against 113.41/46 in late Europe on Wednesday.
